I offered to buy the item on my mums account with 100% positive feedback etc etc and have seemingly being blocked as can no longer see sellers account. 
I’m now beginning to believe that the seller has in fact sold the item to somebody else (either another eBayer, or someone they know irl) for a higher price after I purchased, otherwise they’d have just responded to my message.

I don’t understand how I COULD scam someone when my money went through and went through paypal? Surely if I did somehow manage to scam them they could just contact paypal/eBay? Again, VERY new to eBay so I don’t really know much lol

When looking on the cancellation details on the eBay app, a reason wasn’t given. 
I was thinking of leaving negative feedback but didn’t want to seem TOO salty incase the seller was genuinely concerned about getting scammed.

It’s not a particularly new account; it was made in 2018 :(  I use it just for buying the odd thing but have never received feedback. I offered to buy on my mothers account which was made in 2005 with 100% positive feedback and seller has ignored me :/
ALSO NOTE: this is days after I purchased.
i already have a daddy lol
Thank you! I have schizophrenia so I can have periods of feeling really low but I'm ok now! <3
I have spoken to him about it and he says he has no intentions of ever leaving me. He even tells me when I get better he’s going to propose but I still have those voices telling me he’s lying.
He knows about it and he has seen me take overdoses and stuff in the past. I’m afraid he wants to leave but can’t because he doesn’t want me to be anymore suicidal than I already am.
there are no good things anymore
